newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ACC share down 11.8 pct in kerb.
newsitem.headline: India's ACC share down 11.8 pct in kerb.

text.p: Shares of India's leading cement maker Associated Cement Companies (ACC) slid 11.8 percent to 1,020 rupees in off-market kerb deals on Tuesday after the firm said its first half net profit fell sharply, traders said.
ACC said its net profit fell 56 percent to 550.5 million rupees in the first six months to September 30, 1996 against 1.25 billion rupees.
The results fell sharply below market expectations of a net profit of around 900 million rupees.
ACC said it could not recover an unprecedented increase in input cost, affecting margins.
